fields.name: APSR
fields.description: Always-on PDU session requested: 0 - Always-on PDU session not requested, 1 - Always-on PDU session requested. Bits 2, 3 and 4 are spare and shall be coded as zero.

notes: The purpose of the Always-on PDU session requested information element is to indicate whether a PDU session is requested to be established as an always-on PDU session.
The Always-on PDU session requested information element is coded as shown in figure 9.11.4.4.1 and table 9.11.4.4.1.
The Always-on PDU session requested is a type 1 information element.
